findings.observation: P0 critical-failure runbook instructed resume via --resume-from <run_id>, a flag that does not exist on bioetl run; preconditions listed Loki.
findings.method: read runbook; grep resume-from in CLI; read command_entrypoint.py; re-verify after patch
findings.actual: Pre-fix used --resume-from and Loki/Local. Post-fix: published flags + local logs.
findings.impact: Operator following the P0 runbook could not resume.
findings.root_cause: Runbook last verified 2026-04-03; CLI resume selectors evolved without this page.
findings.remediation: Replace --resume-from with published flags; drop Loki precondition.
findings.automation: optional runbook-command grep against click options

findings.observation: P0/P1 data-recovery runbook used Spark SQL RESTORE TABLE; runtime is deltalake (delta-rs) with rebuild via bioetl run --run-type rebuild.
findings.method: read data-recovery.md; grep RESTORE TABLE; read retention_time_travel.py
findings.expected: DR steps use local Delta time-travel reads or documented rebuild.
findings.actual: Pre-fix SQL RESTORE TABLE. Post-fix: Polars read-only snapshot + rebuild.
findings.impact: Operators may attempt Spark SQL against a local delta-rs table.
findings.root_cause: Generic Delta Lake SQL copied into a local-only runbook.
findings.remediation: Replace SQL with Polars/delta-rs snapshot; keep rebuild-from-Bronze.

evidence.observation: Negated Spark SQL; Polars time-travel snapshot documented.

findings.observation: Published env-var reference claimed completeness, documented non-existent BIOETL_CHEMBL_API_KEY, and omitted BIOETL_UNIPROT_API_KEY.
findings.expected: Reference lists only wired keys or explicitly scopes itself as partial.
findings.actual: Post-fix: UniProt key present; ChEMBL key removed; page marked partial.
findings.impact: Contributors set unused keys and miss the UniProt optional key.
findings.root_cause: Reference not generated from configs/providers or .env.example.
findings.remediation: Delete BIOETL_CHEMBL_API_KEY; add BIOETL_UNIPROT_API_KEY; mark partial.

findings.observation: Security policy examples list BIOETL_CHEMBL_API_KEY and BIOETL_PUBCHEM_API_KEY; those names are not wired in configs/providers.

findings.expected: Examples match real BIOETL_{PROVIDER}_{KEY} names used by adapters.
findings.actual: Examples still invent ChEMBL/PubChem keys. Out of cycle file SCOPE.
findings.impact: Security onboarding invents credentials the runtime never reads.
findings.root_cause: Generic provider-key pattern copied as concrete examples.
findings.remediation: Replace examples with wired keys. Follow-up outside SCOPE.
